method: Sum the per-criterion median of parent initial and two fresh-context model-blinded image reviews.
major_differences: Flat rectangular seat rather than curved bucket seat.
Simplified wide nose and small front plate rather than sculpted nose and wraparound front bumper.
Wheel plane nearly horizontal, column too upright and protruding above hub.
Cylinder-like tires with little visible rim recess or shoulder rounding.
Simplified front steering links, joints, engine casing, exhaust and drive details.
Engine placed more behind the seat instead of reproducing the clearly offset side-rear arrangement.
limitations: One generated artifact only; not a general model score.
Reference is one perspective screenshot; exact dimensions and hidden geometry are not scored.
Review contexts were independent and model-blinded, but the reviewers share an assistant model family; agreement is not evidence from human experts.
Previously inherited-context pilot agents were interrupted and excluded.
